title: Powerball Odds Worsened To 1 In 292,201,338
hook: Powerball made your jackpot chance 1 in 292,201,338.
closing: Bigger jackpots came from making every ticket less likely to win.
question: Do worse odds change your choice?

segments.say: Lightning's lifetime odds are 1 in 15,300, dramatically likelier than a Powerball jackpot.
A lifetime shark attack is 1 in 11.5 million, still far likelier than Powerball.
Powerball worsened from 1 in 175 million to 1 in 292,201,338 after 2015.
